title: Word Building and Vocabulary
goal: Build the learner's first working vocabulary and word skills — from word structure and formation to 23 thematic word sets — with every word heard, said, read and used in context.

modules.title: Word Knowledge
modules.description: What words are made of: structure, syllables, three- and four-letter words, spelling patterns, word families, compounds, prefixes, suffixes and word formation.

lessons.title: What Is a Word? Word Structure
objectives: Explain what a word is
Break a word into letters and sounds
lessons.assessment: Count words in a sentence and split 5 words into letters

lessons.title: Letters and Syllables
objectives: Hear syllable breaks in words
Clap and count syllables
lessons.assessment: Count syllables correctly in 8 of 10 words

lessons.title: Three-Letter and Four-Letter Words
objectives: Read and spell common three- and four-letter words
Build words letter by letter
lessons.assessment: Read and spell 16 of 20 short words

checkpoint.criteria: Explain word structure, count syllables and read/spell short words

lessons.title: Common Spelling Patterns
objectives: Read CVC, CVCe and double-letter patterns
Choose the right pattern when spelling
lessons.assessment: Apply spelling patterns to 8 of 10 words and flag 2 known exceptions

lessons.title: Word Families
objectives: Read word families like -at, -an, -ing and -og
Build new words by swapping onset letters
lessons.assessment: Generate 6 of 8 correct family members from a rime

checkpoint.criteria: Use spelling patterns and word families when reading and spelling

lessons.title: Compound Words
objectives: Build compounds from two words like bedroom and raincoat
Split compounds into their parts
lessons.assessment: Build or split 8 of 10 compound words with correct meaning

lessons.title: Prefixes
objectives: Understand how un- and re- change meaning
Decode new words using prefixes
lessons.assessment: Explain and use 8 of 10 prefixed words correctly

lessons.title: Suffixes
objectives: Understand how -s, -er and -ing attach to words
Form correct spelling changes when adding suffixes
lessons.assessment: Add suffixes correctly to 8 of 10 base words

lessons.title: Word Formation Overview
objectives: Combine families, compounds, prefixes and suffixes to grow vocabulary
Explain how a new word was built
lessons.assessment: Build and explain 6 of 8 target words from parts

checkpoint.criteria: Build words with compounds, prefixes and suffixes and explain their structure

modules.title: Word Meaning and Relationships
modules.description: How words relate: singular and plural forms, synonyms, antonyms, homophones, homonyms, collocations and a first look at phrasal verbs.

lessons.title: Singular and Plural Forms
objectives: Form regular plurals with -s and -es
Recognise common irregular plurals like children and feet
lessons.assessment: Form 16 of 20 plurals correctly including 4 irregulars

checkpoint.criteria: Transform singular to plural including common irregular forms

lessons.title: Synonyms
objectives: Match words with similar meanings like big and large
Choose the best synonym for a context
lessons.assessment: Match 8 of 10 synonym pairs and use one in a sentence

lessons.title: Antonyms
objectives: Match opposite word pairs like hot and cold
Use antonym pairs in simple sentences
lessons.assessment: Match 9 of 10 antonym pairs

lessons.title: Homophones
objectives: Hear that words like to, two and too sound the same
Choose the correct homophone in writing
lessons.assessment: Choose correct homophones in 8 of 10 sentences

lessons.title: Homonyms
objectives: Understand words with one form and two meanings like bat
Decide meaning from context
lessons.assessment: Explain both meanings of 6 of 8 homonyms with examples

lessons.title: Collocations
objectives: Recognise natural word partners like make coffee and do homework
Reject unnatural pairings
lessons.assessment: Choose the natural collocation in 8 of 10 items

checkpoint.criteria: Navigate synonyms, antonyms, homophones, homonyms and collocations

lessons.title: Phrasal Verbs: Introduction
objectives: Understand that verb plus particle makes a new meaning like get up
Use 6 high-frequency phrasal verbs
lessons.assessment: Use 5 of 6 target phrasal verbs correctly in context

checkpoint.criteria: Recognise and use the six target phrasal verbs

modules.title: People and Emotions
modules.description: Thematic vocabulary for people, relationships, family and emotions — the first full thematic sets, taught to the 12-field vocabulary standard.

lessons.title: People Words: Who We Are
objectives: Learn 10-12 core people words like man, woman, boy and friend
Describe who someone is in one sentence
lessons.assessment: Recognise and produce all core people words; describe 3 pictures

lessons.title: Relationships: Family, Friends and Others
objectives: Learn relationship words like neighbour, classmate and best friend
Talk about who people are to you
lessons.assessment: Use 8 of 10 relationship words in sentences about your life

checkpoint.criteria: Use people and relationship vocabulary accurately in description and dialogue

lessons.title: Family Members
objectives: Learn 14-16 family words from mother to grandparents
Ask and answer the question: Is this your family member?
lessons.assessment: Name 14 of 16 family members on a family tree from audio

lessons.title: Talking about Your Family
objectives: Describe your family in 3-4 sentences
Understand a simple family introduction dialogue
lessons.assessment: Speak 4 sentences about your family and answer 3 questions

checkpoint.criteria: Describe a family accurately and understand family dialogues

lessons.title: Feelings and Emotions
objectives: Learn 12 feeling words from happy to tired
Say how you feel today and why in one sentence
lessons.assessment: Match 11 of 12 emotion words to situations and use them in answers

checkpoint.criteria: Name emotions and express feelings in simple sentences

modules.title: Body and Health
modules.description: Body parts, describing people, health and illness vocabulary, and first doctor conversations.

lessons.title: Parts of the Body
objectives: Learn 14-16 body words from head to feet
Point to and name body parts on request
lessons.assessment: Name 14 of 16 body parts; respond to 8 touch-and-name prompts

lessons.title: Describing People and Bodies
objectives: Describe height, hair and age with simple adjectives
Understand descriptions and identify the person
lessons.assessment: Describe 2 people so a listener identifies them from 4 options

checkpoint.criteria: Name body parts and describe people physically

lessons.title: Health and Illness Words
objectives: Learn illness words like headache, cold and fever
Say what hurts using My ... hurts
lessons.assessment: Match 10 of 12 illness words to situations and produce My...hurts sentences

lessons.title: At the Doctor: First Conversation
objectives: Follow and produce a 6-line doctor dialogue
Answer the questions: How do you feel, and what hurts?
lessons.assessment: Complete a doctor role-play exchanging 6 turns

checkpoint.criteria: Describe symptoms and complete a first doctor conversation

modules.title: Home, Food and Clothes
modules.description: Everyday living vocabulary: rooms, furniture, household objects, food and drink, meals, clothes and describing what people wear.

lessons.title: Rooms and Furniture
objectives: Learn 12-14 words for rooms and main furniture
Describe where things are in a home
lessons.assessment: Label 12 of 14 rooms and furniture items correctly

lessons.title: Things at Home
objectives: Learn 12 household objects from chair to window
Say what is in a room using there is / there are
lessons.assessment: Describe a room with 5 correct there is/are sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Describe a home: rooms, furniture and objects with there is/are

lessons.title: Food and Drink
objectives: Learn 16 core food and drink words
Sort foods into categories like fruit, drink and meat
lessons.assessment: Recognise all core food words and sort 14 of 16 into categories

lessons.title: Meals and Eating
objectives: Use meal words breakfast, lunch and dinner with times
Say what you like, love and do not like
lessons.assessment: Talk about your meals and preferences in 5 sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Name foods and meals and express likes and dislikes

lessons.title: Clothes and Accessories
objectives: Learn 12-14 clothing words from shirt to shoes
Match clothes to weather and situations
lessons.assessment: Name 12 of 14 clothing items and match 8 to situations

lessons.title: Describing Clothes
objectives: Describe what someone is wearing with colours
Identify a person from a clothing description
lessons.assessment: Describe 2 people's clothing so a listener identifies them

checkpoint.criteria: Name clothes and describe what people are wearing

modules.title: Numbers, Time, Colours and Shopping
modules.description: The number system, telling the time, days, months and dates, colours, shops, products, money and prices.

lessons.title: Numbers 1-20
objectives: Count from 1 to 20 aloud
Recognise numbers heard quickly
lessons.assessment: Count 1-20 and identify 10 of 12 numbers by ear

lessons.title: Numbers 20-100 and Beyond
objectives: Say and understand numbers to 100 and to 1000
Use numbers for ages, quantities and years
lessons.assessment: Write 8 of 10 dictated numbers correctly; say 5 ages and years

checkpoint.criteria: Count, understand and use numbers to 100 and beyond

lessons.title: Telling the Time
objectives: Say times with o'clock, half past and quarter past/to
Ask and answer the question: What time is it?
lessons.assessment: Tell 8 of 10 clock times correctly and ask for the time

checkpoint.criteria: Tell the time and exchange times in dialogue

lessons.title: Days, Months and Dates
objectives: Say the days of the week and months in order
Say and write dates like the 3rd of May
lessons.assessment: Order all months and write 5 dates correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Use days, months and dates accurately

lessons.title: Colours and Shades
objectives: Learn 10-12 colour words
Describe objects with colour plus noun order
lessons.assessment: Use 10 colour words correctly in descriptions

checkpoint.criteria: Describe things using colour vocabulary correctly

lessons.title: Shops and Products
objectives: Learn shop types and common products
Say where you buy things
lessons.assessment: Match 10 of 12 products to the right shop

lessons.title: Money and Prices
objectives: Ask and say prices: How much is it?
Understand prices said aloud and written
lessons.assessment: Complete a 6-turn shopping dialogue including price questions

checkpoint.criteria: Shop vocabulary mastery: products, shops, money and prices in dialogue

modules.title: The World Around Us
modules.description: Weather, animals, transport, travel words and travel situations, and nature and environment vocabulary.

lessons.title: Weather Words
objectives: Learn 10-12 weather words from sunny to snowy
Ask and answer the question: What is the weather like?
lessons.assessment: Describe 6 weather pictures and answer the weather question

checkpoint.criteria: Describe weather and exchange weather information

lessons.title: Animals and Pets
objectives: Learn 12-14 animal words including pets and farm animals
Say which animals you like and have
lessons.assessment: Name 12 of 14 animals and talk about pets in 3 sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Name animals and talk about them simply

lessons.title: Transport and Getting Around
objectives: Learn 10-12 transport words
Say how you travel: by bus, by car, on foot
lessons.assessment: Use 10 transport words and by-phrases correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Name transport modes and describe how you travel

lessons.title: Travel Words and Places
objectives: Learn 12-14 travel words from ticket to suitcase
Understand simple travel announcements
lessons.assessment: Recognise all travel words and understand 3 announcements

lessons.title: Travel Situations: Airport and Hotel
objectives: Handle check-in and simple airport situations
Ask 3 hotel questions: room, key, breakfast
lessons.assessment: Complete airport and hotel role-plays of 6 turns each

checkpoint.criteria: Use travel vocabulary in airport and hotel situations

lessons.title: Nature and the Environment
objectives: Learn 10-12 nature words like tree, river and sky
Describe a simple natural scene
lessons.assessment: Describe a nature scene using 8 target words

checkpoint.criteria: Use nature and environment vocabulary to describe scenes

modules.title: School, Work and Society
modules.description: Education and classroom words, jobs, the workplace, everyday technology, and people and places in society.

lessons.title: School and University Words
objectives: Learn 12-14 school words from teacher to student
Describe your school simply
lessons.assessment: Label 12 of 14 school items and describe your school in 3 sentences

lessons.title: Subjects and the Classroom
objectives: Name school subjects like maths and history
Follow 8 classroom instructions
lessons.assessment: Match 8 subjects and respond to 8 classroom instructions

checkpoint.criteria: Use school vocabulary and follow classroom language

lessons.title: Jobs and Work Words
objectives: Learn 12-14 job words from doctor to driver
Ask the question: What do you do?
lessons.assessment: Name 12 of 14 jobs and exchange what-do-you-do dialogues

lessons.title: Describing Your Job
objectives: Say where you work and what you do in 3 sentences
Understand simple job descriptions
lessons.assessment: Describe a real or imagined job in 4 sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Talk about jobs: names, workplaces and activities

lessons.title: The Workplace and Office Words
objectives: Learn 12 office words from meeting to colleague
Describe a typical workplace
lessons.assessment: Use 12 workplace words correctly in descriptions

lessons.title: Colleagues and Work Life
objectives: Talk about colleagues and work routines
Understand a simple workplace dialogue
lessons.assessment: Talk about work life in 4-5 sentences and understand a workplace dialogue

checkpoint.criteria: Discuss workplaces, colleagues and routines with core office vocabulary

lessons.title: Everyday Technology
objectives: Learn 12 technology words from phone to internet
Say which devices you use and what for
lessons.assessment: Use all 12 technology words and describe 3 devices you use

lessons.title: Using Phones and Computers
objectives: Use action words like send, download and charge
Handle simple digital situations: password, message, app
lessons.assessment: Complete a phone-help dialogue using 6 tech action words

checkpoint.criteria: Use everyday technology vocabulary for devices, actions and situations

lessons.title: People and Places in Society
objectives: Learn 10-12 words for places and roles in society like city, village and police officer
Describe where you live
lessons.assessment: Use 10 society words in a description of where you live

checkpoint.criteria: Describe community and society with the target vocabulary

exitAssessment.title: Word Builder Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Word structure and formation (compounds, prefixes, suffixes); plural forms; meaning relations (synonyms, antonyms, homophones); listening recognition of 60+ thematic words across all 23 themes; production of 40+ words in context; first dialogues (family, shopping, doctor).
